theorems.name: Submission.idtp_cse_etp_loc_dist_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (a e : Euclid P), Module.finrank ℝ Q = 2 → a ∈ Q → e ∈ Q → ‖a‖ = 1 → ‖e‖ = 1 → inner ℝ a e = 0 → ∀ x : Euclid P, 0 < inner ℝ x a → dist x a ≤ |‖x‖ - 1| + |Real.arctan (inner ℝ x e / inner ℝ x a)| + ‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ / ‖x‖ + (‖x - Q.starProjection x‖ / ‖x‖) ^ 2
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
